sources.snippet: Phonon-2.5 English is an open speech recognition model for English in a 157.6 MB download. Across the Open ASR Leaderboard's seven English sets it averages 4.82 % word error, against 4.94 % for Underdog Bark 3.0, the other low-bit model of this size, and 5.21 % for Phonon-2.
